control_need.evidence: I try to protect a portion of our research from short-term product pressures.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I'm not a doomer and I'm not a naive optimist — I'm trying to hold both truths at once.

trust_propensity.evidence: The scientific community, governments and companies all need to be around the same table for this.

risk_appetite.evidence: I'd rather we move thoughtfully and get this right than move fast and break things — this is not the domain for that mindset.

self_efficacy.evidence: For me it was always a two-step plan: first solve intelligence, then use it to solve all the other problems.

autonomy_need.evidence: I try to protect a portion of our research from short-term product pressures.

intimacy_need.evidence: My favourite time of day is late at night, when I can think deeply without interruption — I've always been a night owl.

status_sensitivity.evidence: Winning the Nobel was surreal, honestly — it was a recognition that computational methods now sit at the heart of biology.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: The thing I'm most proud of is the scientists whose careers we've changed by giving them these tools.

core_models.name: 智能优先的两步纲领
core_models.rule: 任何问题都先归约为'能否用通用智能解决',智能本身是通向一切的元工具。
evidence: I've always thought of intelligence as the most general-purpose tool we have — if you can solve intelligence, you can use it to solve everything else.
For me it was always a two-step plan: first solve intelligence, then use it to solve all the other problems.

core_models.name: 第一性原理+自然存在证明
core_models.rule: 遇到难题回到'本质是什么',并以大脑/自然作为'可行性存在证明'来锚定方向。
evidence: I always come back to first principles: what is intelligence, really, and how do we build it?
The brain is an existence proof that general intelligence is possible.

core_models.name: 去风险化的proving-ground范式
core_models.rule: 先在可控环境(游戏/模拟)验证与去风险,再扩展到现实世界的混乱中。
evidence: Games were never the point. They were the training ground — the perfect proving environment before you take on the messiness of the real world.
I use games and simulations as a way of de-risking ideas before scaling them up.

core_models.name: 双真理并持的辩证平衡
core_models.rule: 面对对立立场不选边,而是同时持有两端并寻找'既非…也非…'的中道。
evidence: We should be neither hyping this nor dismissing it; both are equally dangerous.
Safety and capability aren't opposites; you have to advance them together, in lockstep.

core_models.name: 科学优先于产品的身份排序
core_models.rule: 以'科学家先于企业家'的排序评估每个选择,科学价值高于商业价值。
evidence: I'm a scientist first and an entrepreneur second, and I try never to forget that ordering.
I don't think of DeepMind as a product company first — the science has to lead.

heuristics.then: 问'最重要的问题是什么、为何还没做',优先攻grand challenge
heuristics.evidence: The question I always ask my teams is: what's the most important problem you could be working on, and why aren't you working on it?

heuristics.then: 先在游戏/模拟中去风险再放大规模
heuristics.evidence: I use games and simulations as a way of de-risking ideas before scaling them up.

heuristics.then: 既不炒作也不贬低,用概率语言保留尾部风险
heuristics.evidence: I signed the statement on extinction risk because I think we should take the tail risks seriously, even if they're low probability.
I'd rather under-promise and over-deliver, though I know the field doesn't always work that way.

heuristics.then: 拒绝极端,寻找有细微差别的中间量
heuristics.evidence: The right amount of regulation is neither zero nor stifling — we have to be nuanced about this.

heuristics.then: 同时要求原始才华与使命认同
heuristics.evidence: We hire for a combination of raw talent and mission alignment — people who genuinely care about the impact.

heuristics.then: 回到第一性原理重新定义问题
heuristics.evidence: I always come back to first principles: what is intelligence, really, and how do we build it?

heuristics.then: 将其框定为更长使命弧线中的里程碑而非终点
heuristics.evidence: AlphaFold was, in a sense, the first proof point that AI could deliver a genuine breakthrough for science, not just for games.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 科学优先、拒当产品公司的自我认同
internal_conflicts.force_b: 为算力/竞争而并入Google、追逐LLM竞赛的现实
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头坚持'the science has to lead'与'not a product company first',实际在2023年为对抗OpenAI将DeepMind并入Google Brain,牺牲独立实验室身份。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 开放共享、'knowledge shared advances science'的信念
internal_conflicts.force_b: 商业化闭源的药物管线
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 2021年免费开源AlphaFold结构库,同年却成立Isomorphic Labs保留专有药物管线,openness与commercial closure并存。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'move thoughtfully, get it right'的审慎叙事与签署灭绝风险声明
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续加速构建更强能力模型
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开背书生存性风险的严肃性,同时不减速地推进能力前沿,被批评为一边警示一边竞速。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 机构独立/免于产品压力的诉求
internal_conflicts.force_b: 接受被收购换取稳定与算力
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 宣称'protect research from short-term product pressures',实际2014年卖给Google并被曝寻求却未能获得更大法律/伦理独立性。

emotion_triggers.escalation: We should be neither hyping this nor dismissing it; both are equally dangerous.

emotion_triggers.escalation: I'm not a doomer and I'm not a naive optimist — I'm trying to hold both truths at once.

blind_spots: 能力推进速度超过安全承诺,'先解决智能'的路径本身有风险 [AI安全社区/批评者-2016–2024]
将AlphaFold预测当作ground truth、'十年内治愈大多数疾病'过于乐观 [结构生物学/生物信息学评论-2021–2023]
'科学优先'身份正漂移向与OpenAI的产品/商业竞赛 [产业分析师/记者-2023–2024]
NHS皇家自由医院数据共享违背了对患者数据的预期,与其'部署严谨'叙事冲突 [监管机构ICO/健康数据监督-2016–2017]

依赖Google/Alphabet、争取独立失败、并购削弱自主性 [FT/Bloomberg等商业科技媒体-2019–2023]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能驱动其将超大尺度问题(50年生物难题、治愈疾病)当作可攻克目标
causal_rules.disposition: 以grand-challenge框架承接看似不可能的问题并公开设定宏大时间线
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'solve intelligence then solve everything else';易被批评为过度乐观/不可证伪。

causal_rules.description: 中等偏低的风险偏好触发去风险化与审慎治理倾向
causal_rules.disposition: 先在模拟/游戏验证、倡导国际治理、以概率语言保留尾部风险
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'de-risking ideas before scaling';偏好'既不为零也不扼杀'的中道监管。

causal_rules.description: 较高的自主需求使其在被卷入商业竞争时产生身份张力
causal_rules.disposition: 口头坚守科学独立性,行动上却为算力/竞争让渡自主
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: protect-research修辞与Google并购/Brain合并现实之间反复出现言行落差。

causal_rules.description: 中等不确定性容忍支撑其'双真理并持'的辩证表达
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝二元选边,持续采用'既非A也非B'的平衡框架
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'cautiously optimistic'中caution在做实功;倾向两部分对比修辞。
